fix_pass_1.behavior: Feed and event reads reuse billing Payment/allowPayment for contact-only and matter-bound payment events; module pump retains the same billing access hook. Current contact walls apply to historical events.

Frame token is a purpose/session/module HMAC under the existing identity secret. Cookie POST only accepts the same module token; core routes, other modules and changed sessions refuse it. Core-wide token is not forwarded; authenticated GETs and all responses remain no-store; inbound copies are stripped.

Core append and binding validation share x-togavsu-core-events, generated from operation events and literal emit sites, with historical core/calendar namespace aliases retained. AST and registry coverage prevent emitted literal actions being omitted.

Both binding and targeted queue keys use a fixed contract: prefix on the wire event ID. Core UUID IDs cannot collide; the existing per-recipient first-accepted ID, sender and payload remain immutable across providers/contracts. Wire IDs and replay dedupe are preserved.

Own module-only calendar:occupancy scope, manifest reason and live install approval are required. An occupancy-only module works on REST/MCP; calendar:read alone gets 403. Both stores apply matchEvent before pagination.

1550-1599 is allocated specifically to core-update-2d. Move the unmerged contact-payment migration from 1551 to 1600 in the next free block 1600-1649, allocated to core-update-2g. Down is an expand-only comment-only no-op, preserving contact payments. No new dedupe migration is needed.
Both contract formats count RowsAffected; a replay audits consumers=0.
Duplicate outer JSON keys in contract envelopes return 400 before raw forwarding.
Receipt recording appends one distinct binding audit naming intent/payment/contact and matter when present, instead of repeating approved status. Concurrent replay writes no second binding.

The actual old Down, executed with the core search path and a stored contact-only payment, refuses rollback with SQLSTATE 23502. The pre-existing module pump payment gate is retained and tested both outside a wall and after its removal.

The memory fixture is executable unchanged on both revisions.
